related_adrs: ADR-0349/0359 (Jenkins CI runs the drift gate)
ADR-0564 (zero GraphQL in the owned API surface)
title: API contract single-source-of-truth — one Rust-native source generating/validating REST + gRPC + async + realtime (ZERO GraphQL per ADR-0564)

zero_graphql.decision: ADR-0564 — the owned API surface carries NO GraphQL (no REST-named husk, no generated BFF). The canonical surface set is REST (OpenAPI) + gRPC (proto3) + event/async (AsyncAPI) + realtime (SSE one-way / WebSocket bidi / gRPC-streaming).
zero_graphql.reintroduction_rule: GraphQL is admissible ONLY via a future ADR that explicitly reverses ADR-0564. Absent that ADR, any GraphQL library, .graphql/SDL artifact, or resolver is forbidden in the owned stack (enforcement gate tracked as a separate follow-up).

purpose: Target spec for the shared Rust-native contract SSOT + drift gate. Every public/internal API surface (REST/OpenAPI 3.2.0, gRPC/proto3, event/AsyncAPI 3.1.0, realtime SSE/WebSocket/gRPC-streaming) is GENERATED or VALIDATED from one shared Rust-native source of truth so the surfaces can never drift. GraphQL is NOT part of the owned surface set (ADR-0564). Honest non-claim: this records the canonical contract-SSOT model + launch directives; it does not implement the generators, brokers, adapters, or the runtime drift gate (those are downstream ChangeSets).

single_source_of_truth.form: Rust-native typed contract definitions (the canonical source); OpenAPI 3.2.0 + proto3 + AsyncAPI 3.1.0 are projections generated/validated from it
single_source_of_truth.principle: one source mastered in exactly one place; the wire surfaces are derived projections, never independently hand-edited (SSOT single-master).

surfaces.derivation: generated from the Rust source; api-semver gate enforces -vN suffix + metadata (ADR-0342)
generated from the Rust source; tonic/prost adapters consume the generated bindings
generated/validated from the Rust source where events are typed; the event/messaging contract surface

surfaces.artifact: SSE (one-way server push), WebSocket (bidirectional), and gRPC-streaming bindings
surfaces.derivation: the realtime transports project the same Rust-native typed payloads as REST/gRPC; no separate hand-maintained schema

drift_gate.name: api-contract-ssot-drift (planned)
drift_gate.rule: regenerate the projections from the Rust source and diff against the committed contracts; any divergence (REST/gRPC/async out of sync with the source) fails the gate (lockfile-style, like cargo's Cargo.lock check).
drift_gate.ci: runs under Jenkins (ADR-0359) as a required check

messaging_directives.async_contracts: AsyncAPI 3.1.0 for event contracts, also derived from the shared source where events are typed

non_claims: Records the canonical contract-SSOT model + launch directives only.

Does NOT implement the Rust-native generators, the OpenAPI/proto/AsyncAPI emitters, the realtime (SSE/WebSocket/gRPC-streaming) bindings, the drift gate runtime, message brokers, adapters, or admission controllers.
No runtime, no production readiness; claims stay blocked_until_required_evidence_is_green.
